text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
One, two, three... One... One, two, three,
four...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Phew... Huff, huff... Three sets complete... I think that amount of weight should do it...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I watch from the sidelines as Mejiro Ardan
goes through her workout.
It's on the
lighter side in terms of intensity, and it's
clear she's taking
things slowly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In between each exercise, I see her pull
out a tablet and swipe the
screen. I
wonder what she's doing...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
All right, time to pump some iron—whoa!
It's packed in here! Uh... are
there any
open spaces?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. You can use this space if you'd
like. I've just finished my
workout.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Man, this is my lucky day! Thanks
a lot!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome. Now then, I'll be on
my way.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text:
Wait, she's done already? But she just got
here!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text:
Well... She's not the healthiest, right?
Maybe that's the best she can
do.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She may be a Mejiro, but her poor health
overshadows her family
line...

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. Forcing her to push herself would
be dangerous too... She's
just not built for
the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Tazuna was right. The trainers
obviously don't believe Ardan
has what it
takes to be a racer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that thought, I decide to follow
Mejiro Ardan out of the gym,
hoping to
chat with her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Mejiro Ardan falls to the ground, I rush
to her side, steadying her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, my apologies for worrying you. I
just felt a little
lightheaded, but I'm fine
now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I suppose I worked a little too hard.
I was only discharged
yesterda—oh?
Where's my tablet?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I scan the area around me, and my eyes
fall on a square object right
by my
feet—the very tablet I saw Ardan looking
at in the gym.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I take the tablet into my hands, the
screen lights up, and I'm taken
aback by
what I see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Displaying on the screen is a spreadsheet.
Under each exercise are
notes on the
method, reps, sets, weight used, as well as
her tempo...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even at a glance, it's abundantly clear...
She's dead set on seeing just
how far she
can go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for picking that up for me...
May I have it back now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan takes back her tablet before
walking off. In my stupor, I
completely
forgot that I wanted to talk to her.
Instead, I just stare as
she takes her leave.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even the standard exercises push her body
to the limit, but that
doesn't stop her from
trying. That spreadsheet must be only the

beginning of her resolve.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now hold on... Are you sure, Ardan?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days pass until I see Mejiro Ardan
again, where I find her
standing before a
very concerned Tazuna.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
There should be an open slot, no? If so, I
would like to take it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Please let the staff know that I will be
racing in the 1,200-meter on
the dirt
course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe my ears. I've looked into
Mejiro Ardan's aptitudes, and
what I'm
hearing doesn't—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
But you're more suited to medium-distance
races on a turf course! I'm
not saying it's
impossible for you to win, but your true
potential won't
shine through!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Ardan... Perhaps you could wait for the
next tryouts in a few months?
That way,
you can enter a race better suited to your
talents and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
But those "few months" make a world of
difference... I believe you
and I are both
aware of what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
We Umamusume can only shine for so
long. Once we're race-ready,
our talents
can only decline from there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My repeated hospitalizations have
prevented me from running in the
tryouts...
As such, the time I have after I am
race-ready has been
decreased
significantly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
If I delay my debut any longer, my prime
will be over before I can
even dream of the
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I... don't want that to happen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: But!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I understand your concerns, Ms. Tazuna,
but my mind is made up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Please proceed with my race registration.
